kai: Customer asks to rip out bastions in favor of VPN certs + ephemeral roles. Need a short risk summary (RBAC/KMS/audit/netpol) and a playbook for key revocation.

nora: quick bullets: no ssh-agent forwarding, per-tenant KEK (HSM if possible), node-agent uses workload identity to request short-lived DEK, DEK cached in-memory only.

ishaan: NetPolicy sketch (deny-by-default egress, allow CA, KMS, SIEM):

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: privedge-egress-lockdown-compact
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/16
    ports: [{protocol: TCP, port: 443}]
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector: {matchLabels: {role: siem}}
    ports: [{protocol: TCP, port: 9200}]
```

sec-bot: Added checklist to PR 4102: vpn-ephemeral-rbac, kms-headers, netpol-allowlist.

nora: audit plan: require `x-rw-cluster`,`x-rw-ephemeral-id`,`x-rw-pod` headers on KMS unwraps, ingest into a write-once SIEM index with tamper-evidence hash chain. Correlate with kube-audit via ephemeral-binding id.

kai: migration: dev -> staging -> prod-canary (5%) -> full. GC ephemeral rolebindings after 48h no activity (OPA-controlled) with manual override. Add scripted KEK revoke + DEK rotate runbook.

ishaan: opening infra PR for OPA policy + netpol + runbook today.

kai: thanks — keeping this thread as the audit record for the customer review. :lock:
